title: AT&T breakup testimony before Judge Greene

tellings.quote: AT&T hired me as the final witness

plain: A former presidential adviser named Harold Malmgren says AT&T, the giant American telephone company, hired him as "the final witness" in the government case that broke the company up, heard before Judge Harold Greene in Washington in the early 1980s. Malmgren tells it from his own part in the case, as evidence of how close he stood to major decisions.
